scope.description: Same five-node 900-action stress as the first seed, with seed 0x243f6a8885a308d3 and run id 7, including the fair-delivery convergence phase and the progressed flag.
assumptions: Only the random schedule differs from the previously interpreted run; the harness logic, drop rate and convergence phase are identical.
Messages may be delivered out of order or dropped; ticks drive elections and resends.
No snapshots, trimming or reconfiguration are used.
excluded: Snapshots, compaction, flexible quorums, reconfiguration, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

basis.prefix: Identical to randomized_lossy_agreement: build nodes 1..5, settle, then run 900 randomized actions (25 percent append, 20 percent tick, otherwise deliver or 12 percent drop a random queued message), collect outgoing after each action, cap the queue at 4000, and compare all decided prefixes. After the loop, deliver everything and tick every node for up to 40 rounds, compute progressed, and emit the safety event with run 7.

comparisons.description: Agreement under the second seeded schedule: with progressed true, no two nodes may report different values at any index both have decided.
